# 2 Baruch Chapter 29 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Second Fast and Dialogue

---

**29:1** And-he-answered and-said to-me: Whatever-will-be-then, those-who-will-be-living [upon-the-earth] — they-will-rejoice.

**29:2** And-it-will-come-to-pass at-that-time that-the-treasure-of-manna will-descend-again from-on-high, and-they-will-eat-of-it in-those-years, because-these-are-they-who-have-come to-the-consummation-of-the-times.

**29:3** And-it-will-come-to-pass at-that-time that-the-reservoirs-of-dew will-open, and-from-on-high they-will-descend, and-from-below they-will-spring-up; and-they-will-again-eat-of [the fruit of]-the-earth.

**29:4** And-it-will-come-to-pass at-that-time that-Behemoth will-be-revealed from-his-place, and-Leviathan will-ascend-from-the-sea — those-two-great-monsters which-I-created on-the-fifth-day-of-creation and-I-have-kept until-that-time; and-then-they-will-be-food for-all-who-remain.

**29:5** The-earth also will-yield her-fruit ten-thousand-fold, and-on-one-vine will-be-a-thousand-branches, and-each-branch will-produce a-thousand-clusters, and-each-cluster will-produce-a-thousand-grapes, and-each-grape will-produce a-cor-[of-wine].

**29:6** And-those-who-are-hungry will-rejoice; and-moreover they-will-see-marvels every-day.

**29:7** For-winds will-go-out before-me every-morning-[to-bring] the-fragrance-of-aromatic-fruits, and-at-the-end-of-the-day clouds-of-healing-dew will-descend.

**29:8** And-it-will-come-to-pass at-that-time that-the-treasury-of-manna will-again-descend from-on-high, and-[the people] will-eat-of-it in-those-years, because-they-have-arrived at-the-end-of-the-times.

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Syriac Codex Ambrosianus. Chapter 29 describes the messianic age of abundance. Key elements: returning manna (v.2,8), Behemoth and Leviathan as food (v.4), miraculous vine-yield (v.5). A "cor" (v.5) is a large unit of measure (~220 liters). Note: vv.2 and 8 appear to be a doublet.*
